content: FormSubmit official docs confirm static POST delivery, success redirects, subjects, table templates, honeypots, reCAPTCHA, autoresponses and invisible recipient tokens. Autoresponse does not work when reCAPTCHA is disabled or via AJAX. FormSubmit retains submissions for 30 days in its archive, so it is email-first but not literally zero-retention. Verified 2026-08-29.
